description: Dracula: the night palette's ink-violet background, its purple as the accent, and its comment lavender for secondary text. The subtitle is content rather than a code comment, so the Comment colour is lifted toward the Foreground for the two dimmer text levels — the raw #6272a4 sits at 3:1 on this background, which is how a comment reads but not how a caption should. Geometry and font are Dracula's host's, not Dracula's, so they are left alone and keep the chrome's own.
source: https://spec.draculatheme.com/ — §1.2 Color Palette: Background #282A36, Foreground #F8F8F2, Selection #44475A, Comment #6272A4, Purple #BD93F9, ANSI Black #21222C
